scope: Computational artificial-life research: integer programs on a bounded virtual machine, search operators and simulated populations of software objects. No biological material, organism, procedure or design of any kind.

ruler.normalisation: loss = D2/D3 share over draws (binary); dreward = absolute reward_per_ask change
ruler.denominator: draws (4) per cell; programs paired with themselves
ruler.alters_baseline_function: no: the baseline is the undamaged program; the sham path verifies the route

claims.pd01_length: loss falls with log length (old: fixed-k dose in units); new: slope of loss on log n at each f, permutation band
claims.pd01_operand: operand hits softer than deletions (old .36 vs .72); new: paired sign-flip operand - delete at f .10
claims.pd01_set: C4-08 tops ~.20 more robust than parents / walkers; new: relabel tops vs rest at f .10, and length-conditioned
claims.pe05_depth: orig walks: loss falls 16 -> 64; no_growth: rises; new: paired 64 - 16 at f .10 per rule
claims.pe05_rule: no_growth products lose more at 64; new: paired no_growth - orig at 64
claims.pf06_select: select < ancestor and < ndrift at G60 (6/6 seeds); new: per-seed paired / relabel at f .10, length-conditioned coefficient

disposition_rule: SURVIVES if the new contrast clears its band with the old sign and magnitude >= half the old; SHRINKS if it clears but smaller; REVERSES if it clears with the opposite sign; DISAPPEARS if inside its band; UNRESOLVED if the reread could not be made
